title.narrative: South Sudan Council of Church Renewed Peace Process in South Sudan

description.narrative: South Sudan stands at a critical juncture: the risk of a return to civil war is very high. The Tumaini peace process stopped earlier this year, and the mechanisms monitoring the 2018 peace agreement have stopped functioning. The first vice-president from the opposition party, Riek Machar, is still under house arrest, and head his allies are the subject of court trials. Ugandan armed forces have been deployed with the agreement of President Salva Kiir. At a local level, there is a rise in young people taking up arms, and communal violence continues. These unresolved local grievances provide fertile ground for national political actors to exploit. 1-Catalysing international diplomacy 2-Behind-the-scenes diplomacy with the South Sudan Presidency 3-Shuttle diplomacy within the region 4-Dialogue with holdout groups 5-Engagement with Councils of Elders 6-Engagement with traditional leaders, and shuttle diplomacy within South Sudan
